Why it matters

Scan, then lift.
No holster in between.

With a handheld gun, every scan ends the same way: the scanner goes back on the belt before both hands can take the box. ULTRA SCAN stays on the back of the hand, so the moment the barcode reads, the lift can begin.

Handheld gunGrab→Scan→Holster→Lift
ULTRA SCANScan→Lift

11 / 12

01Low reach

Squatting at the bottom tier. The arm reaches out and the index-finger trigger fires — no scanner to hold or aim.

02Hands full

Both hands stay on the carton. The label is read in passing, without setting the box down.

03Overhead reach

Arm raised to the top rack. Scanning at full reach, with no handheld to pull from a holster.
